name: Exp_Sinewave2_X2
summary: This EA trades based on the Sinewave2 indicator, a digital signal processing (DSP) cycle-based oscillator that identifies trend direction and cycle phase shifts. It uses the crossover of sine and lead sine components to generate buy/sell signals, combined with a second confirmation layer (X2) for improved entry accuracy. The EA systematically enters positions when cycle phase transitions align with trend conditions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Sinewave2指标进行交易，该指标是一种数字信号处理（DSP）周期振荡器，用于识别趋势方向和周期相位变化。它利用正弦波和超前正弦波的交叉来生成买卖信号，并结合第二层确认机制（X2）提高入场准确性。当周期相位转换与趋势条件一致时，EA系统性地开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于John Ehlers的数字信号处理（DSP）正弦波指标，通过将价格数据转换为频域来识别市场周期。入场条件是当正弦波（Sine）与超前正弦波（Lead Sine）发生交叉时，正弦波上穿超前正弦波为做多信号，下穿为做空信号。X2版本增加了第二层确认机制，可能使用双周期或双参数组合来过滤假信号，只有当两层信号同时确认时才入场。出场条件通常包括反向交叉信号平仓以及止损/止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA依赖周期相位识别的准确性，但正弦波指标在非周期性市场（如强趋势或随机游走）中容易产生虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on John Ehlers' digital signal processing (DSP) Sinewave indicator, which transforms price data into the frequency domain to identify market cycles. Entry conditions trigger when the Sine component crosses the Lead Sine component — an upward crossover generates a buy signal, while a downward crossover generates a sell signal. The X2 variant adds a second confirmation layer, likely using dual-period or dual-parameter combinations to filter out false signals, requiring both layers to confirm before opening a position. Exit conditions typically include closing on reverse crossover signals along with stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or equity-proportional sizing methods. In terms of money management, the EA relies on the accuracy of cycle phase identification, but the Sinewave indicator is prone to generating false signals in non-cyclical markets such as strong trends or random walk conditions.

pros: 基于数字信号处理的周期识别方法具有理论严谨性，比传统技术指标更科学
X2双确认机制有效减少了单层信号的虚假交叉，提高了入场质量
正弦波指标在震荡市中表现优异，能精准捕捉周期转折点
pros_en: The DSP-based cycle identification approach is theoretically rigorous and more scientific than traditional technical indicators
The X2 dual-confirmation mechanism effectively reduces false crossovers from a single layer, improving entry quality
The Sinewave indicator performs excellently in ranging markets, accurately capturing cycle turning points
cons: 正弦波指标在强趋势市场中容易产生大量虚假信号，导致频繁亏损交易
缺乏动态止损和移动止损机制，固定止损方式无法适应市场波动变化
没有考虑点差和滑点过滤，在高点差环境下可能频繁触发无效信号
cons_en: The Sinewave indicator tends to generate numerous false signals in strong trending markets, leading to frequent losing trades
Lacks dynamic and trailing stop mechanisms — fixed stops cannot adapt to changing market volatility
No spread or slippage filtering, which may trigger invalid signals in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或长周期均线），仅在震荡市中启用正弦波信号，避免趋势市中的虚假信号
引入ATR动态止损和移动止损机制，根据市场波动性自适应调整止损距离
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or long-period MA) to only enable Sinewave signals in ranging markets, avoiding false signals during trends
Introduce ATR-based dynamic and trailing stop mechanisms that adapt stop distances according to market volatility

risk_points: 正弦波指标在非周期性市场环境下信号可靠性显著下降，可能导致连续亏损
缺乏点差过滤和滑点保护机制，在流动性不足时段可能产生不利成交
risk_points_en: Sinewave indicator reliability drops significantly in non-cyclical market conditions, potentially causing consecutive losses
Lacks spread filtering and slippage protection, which may result in unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods

It uses the crossover of sine and lead sine components to generate buy/sell signals, combined with a second confirmation layer (X2) for improved entry accuracy. The EA systematically enters positions when cycle phase transitions align with trend conditions.
